nasa_psi_validation: No implemented model predicts a quantity measured in the NASA PSI tables, so no model is validated against PSI data. No combustion model is implemented.

records.conclusion: The implementation reproduces the reference density to within its rounding. This is a consistency check, not an experimental validation.
records.independence: Not independent of Model A: the standard atmosphere density is itself defined through the ideal-gas law. Used for VERIFICATION only.
records.reference_source: U.S. Standard Atmosphere, 1976 (NOAA, NASA, USAF), sea-level values
records.uncertainty: Tabulated to 5 significant figures (±0.00005 kg/m³ rounding).

records.conclusion: Mixture molar mass agrees with the standard value; the residual reflects the omitted trace gases.
records.independence: Verification of the mixture molar-mass sum with the four species FIREWISE represents (Ne, He, Kr, Xe and other trace gases omitted).
records.reference_source: U.S. Standard Atmosphere, 1976, composition of dry air at sea level (mole fractions); mean molar mass 28.9644 g/mol
records.uncertainty: Omitted trace species total about 0.003 mole %.

records.conclusion: Heat capacities agree with NIST-JANAF; the largest deviation (N2, about −0.18%) is a property of the published N2 polynomial.
records.independence: The NASA polynomials are fits to evaluated data of this kind; the comparison VERIFIES coefficient transcription and fit quality at 298.15 K.
records.reference_source: NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, 4th ed. (Chase 1998): ideal-gas Cp at 298.15 K

records.conclusion: Maximum deviation 0.51% is within the ±2% reference uncertainty over the domain. Not validated for O₂-enriched compositions or outside 250–400 K.
records.independence: Independent of the model under test: the model mixes N2, O2, Ar and CO2 pure-component data with the Wilke rule; the reference is a separate fit to measured air viscosity.
records.reference_source: White, F. M., Viscous Fluid Flow, 3rd ed. (2006), Table 1-2: Sutherland law for AIR, mu0 = 1.716e-5 Pa·s, T0 = 273 K, S = 111 K (±2% over its stated range)

records.conclusion: Maximum deviation 1.03% is within the ±2% reference uncertainty over the domain. Not validated for O₂-enriched compositions or outside 250–400 K.
records.independence: Independent of the model under test (Mason–Saxena mixture of pure-component conductivities).
records.reference_source: White, F. M., Viscous Fluid Flow, 3rd ed. (2006), Table 1-3: Sutherland-type law for AIR, k0 = 0.0241 W/(m·K), T0 = 273 K, S = 194 K (±2% over its stated range)

records.conclusion: Algebraic definitions (A, V, Q/A, Q/V, Re). Verified by unit tests; there is no velocity-field measurement in PSI or in this project to validate against, so no error metric is reported.
records.domain: Habitat-scale bulk quantities only. It does not resolve local velocities, jets, recirculation or dead zones.

records.conclusion: Classical laminar correlation, implementation verified by unit tests. FIREWISE holds no heat-transfer measurements for inert samples in cabin flow, so no validation metric is reported.
records.domain: Re_L < 5×10⁵ and 0.6 ≤ Pr ≤ 50, non-burning surfaces. In microgravity buoyancy is negligible; at lunar, Mars or Earth gravity buoyancy is present but not modelled.

records.conclusion: Fourier's law, verified by unit tests against hand calculations. No experimental comparison performed; no metric reported.
records.domain: Thin homogeneous walls with known conductivity and surface temperatures.

records.conclusion: Not implemented in v1. Would require: fuel and gas transport properties, flame-sheet assumptions, radiative-loss treatment. Candidate validation data: FLEX (PSI-69) droplet initial diameter, burning-rate and extinction-diameter columns (units of the burning-rate column are unverified).

Not implemented in v1. Would require: detailed or reduced chemical kinetics and radiation models. Candidate validation data: ACME Flame Design / CFI-G extinction and end-mode observations (PSI-10, PSI-159).

Not implemented in v1. Would require: pyrolysis and gas-phase kinetics, sample thermal properties. Candidate validation data: Saffire (PSI-98/99/100) reported spread and burn lengths; BASS/BASS-II observations.
Not implemented in v1. Would require: a validated CFD solver with combustion and radiation submodels. Candidate validation data: Not available in PSI at the needed spatial resolution.
